title: Finite etale stage carrying a prescribed simple root
statement: theorem etaleResidueTriples_simple_root_stage (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra ((Spec R).residueField p) K] [IsSepClosure ((Spec R).residueField p) K] (c : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ((Spec R).residueField p) K)))) (hc : IsColimit c) (ψ : c.pt →+* K) (hψ : ∀ t, ψ.comp (c.ι.app t).hom = ((ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ).hom) : ∀ f : Polynomial c.pt, f.Monic → ∀ a₀ : K, f.eval₂ ψ a₀ = 0 → f.derivative.eval₂ ψ a₀ ≠ 0 → ∃ t : EtaleResidueTriples R p K (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ((Spec R).residueField p) K)), ∃ x : t.B, f.IsRoot (c.ι.app t x) ∧ ψ (c.ι.app t x) = a₀

proof.text: Descend the finitely many coefficients and the simple root data to a pointed etale residue triple, then use the standard etale algebra adjoining a root and the induced residue embedding to obtain the required stage element.

proof_origin: Stacks Project Tags 04GN and 04GP; split from the finite-stage construction in the parent proof.
